findings.title: Root-level vitest not installed; test commands in metrics.jsonl cannot execute
findings.evidence: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-compile.test.ts fails with 'vitest is not recognized'. Root package.json devDependencies has only prettier and sass. vitest 4.1.4 is installed only inside packages/core and packages/cli. Root vitest.config.ts imports from vitest/config which cannot resolve.
findings.suggested_fix: Add vitest to root devDependencies so pnpm vitest run tests/... works as documented in metrics.jsonl and previous epoch TASK.md probe commands.
